learning_outcomes.text: Students acquiring knowledge regarding the processing technology of metallic and non-metallic materials. Both conventional and modern unconventional technologies are presented.
Explaining and interpreting types of technological processes, projects, etc., associated with the field of study.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental phenomena, technological principles and procedures for manufacturing products by erosion (Electric erosion, electrochemical erosion, chemical erosion, complex electric erosion, plasma erosion, electron beam erosion, laser erosion, etc.)

Fundamental phenomena, technological principles and procedures for assembling products by welding and brazing (Principle of welding, electric arc, welding materials, fusion welding - shielded metal arc welding, submerged arc welding, gas shielded arc welding or active gas welding, electroslag welding, electron beam welding, laser welding, flame welding - , by pressure - spot welding, butt welding, friction welding, plastic deformation welding)
Determination of technological parameters for open electric arc welding, under protective flux layer, MIG-MAG, spot pressure welding, ultrasonic welding
Study of the influence of technological parameters on processing by electric erosion with solid and wire electrode, complex electric and electrochemical erosion
teaching_methods: Presentation of practical procedures and equipment

assessment_methods.method: Ongoing assessment (including laboratory activity, participation, written tests, oral examination, and practical activity monitoring)

assessment_rules: A minimum passing grade of 5 is required for each subject on the exam. The minimum overall grade for passing the discipline is 5 (five) for all evaluation criteria, in full compliance with current regulations. Each grade constitutes an acquired asset until graduation.
